name: National Data Centre (Datacenter national du Congo)
developer: Government of Republic of Congo / Central African Backbone (CAB) project, co-financed by African Development Bank (AfDB EUR 52.47M) and Congo government (EUR 14.50M); ~EUR 13.8M allocated for the data centre itself
notes: National sovereign data centre in Bacongo district, Brazzaville (former UAPT site), 3-storey building with basement (server rooms, control/supervision, meeting/conference, energy & cooling). Tier III+ per Digital Business Africa; part of CAB programme incl. 600 km of fibre to Cameroon (341 km) and CAR (281 km) via Congo River. Construction started 2024 (civil works ~60% May 2024, >90% Aug 2025); AfDB president visit Feb 2026 with operationalisation targeted by May 2026; reported put into service as first sovereign national data centre in Central Africa in 2026 (EMAC summit page). Capacity (MW) not published; separate small government data centre (54 racks/156 sqm) exists in Pointe-Noire (different department).

name: ARPCE Data Centre (Siege de l'ARPCE)
developer: ARPCE (Agence de Regulation des Postes et des Communications Electroniques)
notes: Data centre operated by the Congolese telecoms regulator at its headquarters in Brazzaville (approx. 6,232 sq ft building per DataCenterJournal); listed among three data centres in Brazzaville (with Ministry of Finance and MTN Congo) cited from ARPCE's own website (2021). Small facility, no published MW capacity.

name: Ministry of Finance Data Centre
developer: Ministry of Finance (Government of Republic of Congo)
notes: Institutional data centre in Brazzaville, listed by ARPCE (2021) as one of three data centres in the capital (with ARPCE and MTN Congo). Existence only indirectly documented via trade press citing the regulator; no public capacity details.

name: MTN Congo Data Centre
notes: Operator data centre in Brazzaville, listed by ARPCE (2021) and on colocation aggregator pages (OCOLO, Yandex Maps). Used for hosting MTN Congo infrastructure and offered for colocation; no published MW capacity.
